title: The Art of Preserving the Tooth
subtitle: Sami & Mina are counting on you
synopsis:
Welcome, Doctor! 🦷

Sami is an enthusiastic dentist, always ready to use the latest trendy composite. Mina is more thoughtful: 'Sami, did you think about adhesion? Pulpal protection? Layering?'

Between a deep cavity, a composite that comes off, a cusp fracture, or recurrent caries under a crown, conservative dentistry is a true art.

A poor choice of material, insufficient adhesion, and the restoration fails. A mastered technique, a good diagnosis, and the tooth is saved for years.

The preservation of dentition, the quality of restorations, and patient satisfaction rest on YOUR shoulders.

chapters.debutant1: Welcome, Doctor! Sami is enthusiastic: 'Direct composite, it's fast and aesthetic!' Mina tempers: 'And adhesion?' Discover the basics of conservative dentistry: materials, adhesion, pulpal protection.
chapters.debutant2: Sami and Mina delve into techniques: inlays, onlays, repairs, recurrent caries. They discover that each clinical situation has its specific solution.
chapters.intermediaire1: Sami and Mina master materials: nanohybrid composites, glass ionomers, adhesive systems. They learn to choose the right material for the right situation.
chapters.intermediaire2: Sami and Mina tackle complex cases: caries under crowns, cusp fractures, inlays/onlays, restoration failures. Technique is put to the test.
chapters.expert1: Sami and Mina become references in conservative dentistry. They train young dentists in the art of tooth preservation and material selection.
chapters.expert2: After years of practice, Sami and Mina leave a legacy of conservative skills. Minimal dentistry is their philosophy.

chapterEndings.debutant1: Sami understood that adhesion is the key. Mina is proud of him.
chapterEndings.debutant2: Sami and Mina master basic techniques. They are ready for more complex cases.
chapterEndings.intermediaire1: Mastery of materials is acquired. Sami and Mina are technical experts.
chapterEndings.intermediaire2: Advanced techniques are mastered. Sami and Mina take on all challenges.
chapterEndings.expert1: Conservative strategy has become a philosophy. Sami and Mina train the next generation.
chapterEndings.expert2: Sami and Mina have accomplished their mission. Tooth preservation is their legacy.
